items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Hunter' is mentioned by the interviewer in a disjointed, inaudible segment regarding degrees and video, with no response or connection from Gil Evans.

ctx.x: Where did you get your degrees?

Hunter ... (inaudible). Anyway, (I don't agree with that doctorate.)? (inaudible falsehood?). I don't know what I'd do with it. I just have to do video now with my crazy net video audience. I'm going around doing as much as I can on video tapes.
Well I watched you with the equipment the other night and I think something happened to it.
